entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: DEDICATED visual-effects art-direction sheet, not a redesign or a full-machine beauty shot.
Reference shows the spherical AI optical curator. Use ONLY its underside gold emitter, part of the ivory camera head, and one black/gold record for scale/material context. Omit the pedestal, arm, magazine, controls, building and all UI.

Make a wide three-panel close-up storyboard of the optical TRACTOR FIELD, with consistent emitter and disc size/camera in all three panels, nearly black charcoal neutral backdrop, elegant high-end AAA cinematic VFX art. Small top labels only: "01 ACQUIRE", "02 HOLD", "03 RELEASE". Each panel is a large readable field close-up with both endpoints. The record is .84 in diameter; emitter is .12 in diameter. Clear visible short air gap about .18 between emitter lip and suspended disc. Disc never changes diameter.

ACQUIRE: emitter iris opens. Six precise pale-amber ranging threads touch six radial anchor points near the record center, a very fine concentric interference pattern wakes on the actual opaque vinyl surface. A narrow light envelope is just beginning to form around those threads. The optical rays end on the record; nothing goes through it. A few minute flecks gather INWARD toward the anchor points, no outward explosion. The plate starts to lift gently, supported by controlled field.

HOLD: the beautiful peak of the field art. Short tapered three-dimensional volume from emitter to record, composed of a delicately luminous translucent interior, multiple separated razor-thin warm white-gold strands, interleaved dark gaps, traveling compressed interference bands, and faint tiny blue secondary fringes near the edge. Clear perspective and spatial layering: near strands cross in front of the dim volume, far strands behind; it must not look like a flat triangle or an ordinary flashlight beam. Six contact nodes are concentrated and bright on the grooves, nearby gold edge and black vinyl receive localized light reflections. Volume remains mostly transparent; elegant rather than noisy. Subtle coherent floating grains flow UPWARD toward the emitter, while disc stays rigid, stable, horizontal. Field brightness is earned at contacts, not one uniform opaque cone. No smoke, giant magical rings, lightning webs or fireworks.

RELEASE: the same disc now rests flush on a small pale-nickel platter with diameter .90, leaving only a thin supporting rim. The .84 disc is unchanged. Emitter remains above it but field strands sequentially retract UPWARD into the emitter after contact, only the upper remnant remains, and surface contact marks fade. A tiny single soft confirmation pulse at the emitter, no ground splash. It is clear that the record is supported by the platter before field disappears.

Show top of emitter only as a tightly cropped portion of reference head. No full robot and no full base. Strong material realism: opaque deep black radial vinyl, machined champagne gold lip, ivory glazed ceramic edge; subtle cool studio fill. Actual VFX appearance takes 70% of attention. Technical controlled optical sci-fi feel consistent with Atomic Heart. No text except the three headings, no arrows, no dimension scribbles, no user interface. Production visual target with visible depth, emitter origin, solid-surface occlusion, and intentional disappearance.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: dedicated visual-effects storyboard for READING AN ARCHIVE RECORD. Three wide close-up panels. This is not a full machine image, not a UI screen and not a redesign.
Use the reference only for the black/gold disc and sinuous gold/ivory optical tonearm material/identity. Show ONLY the SAME ONE record on its small nickel platter, and the optical tonearm's distal head. No pedestal, magazine, robot face, controls or printed building. Dark charcoal background, precision cinematic hard-surface closeup. Small headings only: "01 CONTACT", "02 DECODE", "03 HAND-OFF".

Record .84 diameter, small supporting platter .90 diameter, equal size across all panels. Deep BLACK grooved vinyl, finely scalloped gold rim. Disc has a tiny ivory center label around central aperture. Tonearm is a gold cylindrical optical head on curved ivory body; a small DOWNWARD ruby contact lens addresses one exact groove, not the large side-facing red cap. Light must originate from that small downward lens. No light through the opaque record, no lower ground beams. Fixed close-up front three-quarter camera across all three panels; perspective shows disc surface and light contact clearly.

01 CONTACT: head at outer recorded groove. A tiny sharply focused warm-white contact core with ruby-red outer fringe touches the groove. The nearest five groove tracks catch a brief delicate amber arc, as if the records contain optical data. Keep most of the disc dark black, with satin reflections, no giant glow.

02 DECODE: the visual reward is coherent structured motion encoded in a static keyframe. Three narrow groups of amber light dashes and moving comb-shaped scanlets follow concentric real vinyl groove paths INWARD toward the center, leaving short precise fading trails. Fine cyan secondary diagnostic traces appear only where decoded segments resolve, against dominant amber gold. Dashes echo the pitch of real grooves, not arbitrary magical symbols. The downward reading lens stays the brightest small contact, its gold underside receives bounce light. Six subtle sectors route the decoded traces toward the center. A few tiny data grains follow grooves on the SURFACE, not a storm of sparkles in the air. Delicate engineered optical character from Atomic Heart, rich multilayered AAA art, restrained clutter and beautiful fine detail. The neighboring areas remain visibly opaque black material.

03 HAND-OFF: tonearm lifted visibly clear of disc. Scan trails have condensed into a miniature luminous white-gold seed just above the center label, no wider than .05 of disc diameter, surrounded by a small precise six-lobed circuit of amber lines anchored to the center. The rest of the disk returns dark, only the last two faint arc trails fade near the center. No projected building yet, this is the unmistakable ready-to-print cue. All old contact light at the raised tonearm is OFF.

Controlled bloom only at local bright contacts, no opaque laser cone, no gratuitous lightning, no HUD/callouts/floating text, no big circular spell outline. Clear before/during/after, expensive film-like gold reflections and fired ceramic glaze. Effects occupy the visual attention while the disc size and physical reading logic stay consistent.

Use case: stylized-concept. Dedicated PRINTING VFX art-direction storyboard, three large close-up panels, not a full-machine picture.
Reference fixes the exact ivory/gold observatory miniature design and the small black record it grows from. Show ONLY this miniature and its original black record resting on a thin nickel platter, against deep charcoal. Omit AI head, arm, magazines, pedestal and controls completely. This crop is about the effect, not another robot beauty shot.
Small panel labels: "01 WEAVE", "02 CAST", "03 ALIVE". Same camera, same tower geometry, same record diameter in all three panels. Wide sophisticated production concept sheet, cinematic close-up asset quality, no UI or explanatory callout boxes.

The final miniature must match reference: ivory curved shell tower, fine gold ribs and columns, open Gothic-like but industrial arches, clockwork orb mechanism/clock face at middle, curved spiral stair, gold orrery cage with a ruby sun on the crown. It is fully volumetric with internal gears, layered components and real material thickness. Tower footprint around .65 of record diameter; height about 1.2 record diameters. The .84 record nearly fills the .90 platter. Never shrink or enlarge the disc between panels.

01 WEAVE, about one third through building: six differentiated strand bundles stream up from six radial sectors on the black vinyl into the tower's actual columns, gear hubs and arch joints. Narrow warm-gold material threads, small coherent grains traveling ALONG them, darker gaps and depth between bundles. Lower third is already physical reflective gold structure. Above it, precise cold ice-blue skeletal ribs and wire-detail of the actual future tower, partially incomplete at the top, delicate depth-occluded 3D drawing. It must be readable as the SAME final observatory, not a generic hologram cylinder. The blue scaffolding ends naturally at its thin lines, no translucent filled-blue rectangular mass. Grooves on the record route energy to six origin points.

02 CAST, the clear spectacular crescendo, about three quarters built: rich actual finished metal and glazed ivory in the lower part; thin unfinished pale-blue scaffold on the remaining upper part. A narrow but intensely beautiful WHITE-GOLD formation frontier wraps over the actual curved architecture at the building height; it forms local complex braided curves and short close-following trails around real surfaces, not a giant horizontal magic ring. Hundreds of fine purposeful micron sparks concentrate in a narrow spatial band around that frontier, streaming INWARD into panel seams and screw/rivet seats, extinguishing on contact. Warm coherent threads below continue feeding that frontier from disc sectors. Local gold-hot joins cool into satin brass; ivory glaze seals smoothly onto its backing. Film-like bloom from fine white cores and amber fringes, a little cool chromatic edge, no overexposed slab, no random firecracker spray, no smoke billboard. Bright local bounce lights reveal form on neighboring ceramic, shadows/occlusion distinguish front and rear strands. This is the visually strongest panel; fine spatial richness and a heroic tactile material reveal, not merely a dim thin line.

03 ALIVE: exactly the SAME shape now completely opaque physical ivory, gold, glass and ruby. All cold scaffold, feeding strands and loose construction particles have vanished. Only small practical warm light around the ruby core and a fading glint on a few real gold grooves. Clockwork begins turning and the ruby orrery crown wakes. Show excellent solid-material clarity, no persistent holographic haze or cloud of glitter. The ORIGINAL black record remains under the model with a visible black annulus; ready for slow shared rotation.

Refined Atomic Heart retrofuturist optical engineering aesthetic. Strong curved ivory ceramics, structural champagne gold, pale nickel, dark vinyl; no dirty black metal wash, cloth texture or cartoon plastic. Detailed visible before/peak/after. No UI, pedestal, giant free-space circles, generic lightning web, fantasy runes, outer arrows, or text beyond the headings.

entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Dedicated reverse-print / safe recovery VISUAL EFFECT storyboard for the exact observatory miniature in the reference. Three close-up panels with fixed camera, equal dimensions, charcoal background. Show only the miniature and its original black record on its thin .90 supporting platter. No full pedestal, robot, arm, disc magazine, controls or UI. Labels only: "01 UNMAKE", "02 REWIND", "03 QUIET".

This is calm, deliberate reverse manufacture, not destruction. Copy the exact reference observatory: curved ivory tower, gold framework, real open arches, mechanism globe/clock at center, spiral stair and ruby orrery crown. .84-diameter black disc remains unbroken and motionless on .90-diameter platter in ALL THREE panels. The same unchanging disc is NEVER erased or rebuilt. It must be visibly left behind at the end, ready for the AI to take back.

01 UNMAKE: the fully assembled observatory has stopped its internal motion. Its very top is converting to thin cool pale-blue structural outlines. A narrow soft gold-white deletion frontier moves DOWN the upper third of the exact geometry; glazed panels above that boundary become thin blueprint ribs and then peel into minute coherent material threads. Lower part is still physical gold and ivory. A few short traces flow downward along architectural columns into the record's six radial anchor sectors. No pieces blasting off, no smoke, no flying chunks, no red alarm.

02 REWIND: only the lowest physical gold arches and stair base remain solid; remaining upper silhouette is sparse disappearing fine blueprint, noticeably less dense than in panel 1, not a full permanent hologram. Thin gold filament streams now wind DOWN INTO the black record grooves, short trails and tiny grains moving inward to the center, with 80 percent of the surrounding air completely clear. Residual light focuses around the receding low boundary and the disc's anchor points. Clearly the inverse of constructing this very same tower. Do not show an arbitrary different tower or a small shrunken intact whole model; top geometry disappears progressively while lower dimensions stay constant.

03 QUIET: the ENTIRE observatory is gone including crown, plinth, gear and stair parts. The original black/gold archive record is intact and resting flush on the same thin platter, with the small ivory center label. One last tiny amber line fades into its center, almost fully dark. No floating particles, wireframe ghosts, miniature building remnants, beam or mist. Opaque black satin radial grooves and clean gold edge still beautifully lit by ordinary studio lighting. This clean empty-disc state is required before pickup can begin.

Elegant controlled optical-engineering style from Atomic Heart, AAA art direction, depth-aware emission and local reflections, no magical glyphs, giant rings, random stars or overblown fireworks. The retrieval is a quiet conclusion after the stronger construction crescendo. Material realism and an unmistakable complete disappearance of the building while preserving the real disc. All text limited to three panel labels.

Edit this VFX storyboard. Preserve the first UNMAKE panel completely. Preserve all three headings, frame divisions, lighting, black record and platter size/camera. Correct ONLY the middle and last panel so the three states show actual progressive recovery.

Middle REWIND panel: the upper 75 PERCENT of the tower has already been removed. Keep ONLY the actual bottom quarter of its original geometry: the lowest short arch stubs, lowest stair steps and gold footwork remain attached at their original positions and size. Do NOT show the large central orb, upper clockwork, large central arch, stair upper half, upper pillars or crown as opaque material. They are already gone. In the now-empty space above those very short bottom stubs, show only a few extremely sparse faint thin blue residual lines, clearly discontinuous and fading. Fine warm threads wind downward from these LOW remaining stubs INTO the record's six anchor points. No solid miniature shrunken tower; retain only the true bottom portion at original scale.

Right QUIET panel: ALL VFX have ENDED. Erase the entire vertical line of amber photons above the center and every floating spark. No hovering seed, no light column, no emission or projection anywhere. Leave ONLY the same intact dark black/gold record on the same platter, small ivory label and a tiny ordinary UNLIT metal center spindle. Studio light reflections on metal and vinyl are natural and unchanged. The empty air above the record must be completely clean charcoal background. This is an actual quiet end frame, not a near-finished effect.

Keep the exact record diameter and platter consistent in every panel. No other changes, no new objects or text.

entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a PRODUCTION EMISSION MASK texture for a short structured-light tractor field. This is an actual texture asset, not a scene or concept illustration. ONE square full-frame image. Pure black opaque background, monochrome neutral white/gray light intensity only. No text, no labels, no grid border, no objects, no painted cone, no perspective, no rings, no montage. It will wrap around real 3D volume/line geometry.

An unwrapped optical light curtain: twenty-four thin vertical filaments spaced across the width, going from top toward bottom with precision engineered subtle waviness, mostly straight, coherent parallel trajectories. Fine white cores with only very narrow soft gray falloff, ample clean black between. Vary filament intensities and continuity: six main strands brighter, eighteen finer secondary strands, a few short gaps and bead-like moving photon clusters along them. Add four gentle narrow horizontal compression bands crossing only some strands, discontinuous and very light, not a checkerboard or rigid white rectangle. Each band has fine layered microthreads and darker valleys. No major flares or starburst points. No random smoke. The effect should look sophisticated and optically controlled.

Keep active pattern inside central 90% of image. All four edges fade exactly to pure black in the outer 5%. The vertical strand geometry continues coherently through the bands. Important: background stays flat true black, not mottled photographed gray. White is an intensity mask so runtime can independently choose warm amber or cool-blue tint. Crisp high-resolution studio texture with controlled dynamic range; broad composition of strands and small variation remain readable after mipmapping.

entries.prompt:
Actual production emissive intensity texture for decoded data moving along vinyl grooves. ONE square flat image, not a render or concept picture. PURE BLACK opaque background. Neutral WHITE and gray intensity only so the game can tint it amber/cyan independently. No objects, disc material, metal, shadows, text, labels, arrows, HUD border, magic symbols, perspective or collage.

Perfectly centered circular groove TRACE PATTERN, viewed exactly from above. Pattern outer diameter 80% of image width; empty black center diameter 18%. Three separated clusters of very thin concentric arcs, concentrated around middle and outer radii. Curves centered on the exact image center. Each cluster has several faint continuous hairline arcs and several brighter encoded dashed segments with short fading tails along the arc, a few tiny contact dots; arc lengths and gaps vary in a coherent designed way. Leave large angular regions almost black: this should not become a solid white dense target reticle. Exactly six very subtle short radial feeder traces near the inner annulus converge toward the empty center without crossing the central hole. No big filled ring; hierarchy of bright small data dashes, dim groove traces, and black negative space.

This texture will overlay the ACTUAL 3D record with a swept sector mask and controlled clockwise movement in the renderer. It must show curved tracks clearly enough to survive downsampling, but remain thin and premium rather than a cheap neon circular outline. Tiny narrow bloom only around the brightest dash tips, all edges fade to actual black well before the image boundary. Geometrically concentric, elegant optical engineering micro-pattern, no fantasy decoration.
